newsitem.title: USA: Lunar wins $4.2 mln in patent lawsuit.
newsitem.headline: Lunar wins $4.2 mln in patent lawsuit.

text.p: Lunar Corp said it and co-plaintiff University of Alabama-Birmingham Research Foundation, won $4.2 million in damages in a lawsuit against EG&G Astrophysics and its parent company, EGG Inc.
Lunar said the court found that each of the dual-energy baggage scanners made by EG&G Astrophysics infringed on one or several claims of the patent in dispute.
In addition, the court instituted an injunction against EG&G preventing the manufacture, sale and service of its dual-energy baggage scanners, Lunar said.
Lunar manufactures dual-energy bone densitometers, and is not in the baggage scanning business. The company said it intends to sublicense rights to dual-energy baggage scanners.
EG&G said it was reviewing the court decision and expected to issue a statement shortly.
